messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++20 (64) code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<perturbed_code_1>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

#define Reimu inline void
#define Marisa inline int
#define Sanae inline bool

using LL = long long;
using ULL = unsigned long long;

using Pii = pair<int, int>;
using Tiii = tuple<int, int, int>;
#define fi first
#define se second

template<typename Ty, unsigned N>
using Arr = Ty[N];
template<typename Ty, unsigned N, unsigned M>
using Mat = Ty[N][M];

namespace FastIO {
	template<typename Ty>
	Reimu read(Ty &x) {
		x = 0;
		int f = 0, c = getchar();
		while (!isdigit(c)) { f |= c == '-'; c = getchar(); }
		while (isdigit(c)) { x = (x << 1) + (x << 3) + (c & 15); c = getchar(); }
		if (f) x = -x;
	}

	template<>
	Reimu read(double &x) {
		x = 0;
		int f = 0, c = getchar();
		while (!isdigit(c)) { f |= c == '-'; c = getchar(); }
		while (isdigit(c)) { x = x * 10 + (c & 15); c = getchar(); }
		if (c == '.') {
			double e = 1;
			for (c = getchar(); isdigit(c); c = getchar()) x += (c & 15) * (e *= 0.1);
		}
		if (f) x = -x;
	}

	template<>
	Reimu read(char &c) {
		do c = getchar(); while (!isgraph(c));
	}

	template<>
	Reimu read(string &s) {
		s.clear();
		char c = getchar();
		while (!isgraph(c)) c = getchar();
		while (isgraph(c)) { s += c; c = getchar(); }
	}

	template<typename Ty, typename... Args>
	Reimu read(Ty &x, Args &...args) {
		read(x); read(args...);
	}

	template<typename Ty>
	Reimu print(const Ty &x) {
		if (x < 0) { putchar('-'); print(-x); return; }
		if (x > 9) print(x / 10);
		putchar(x % 10 | 48);
	}

	template<>
	Reimu print(const char &c) {
		putchar(c);
	}

	template<>
	Reimu print(const string &s) {
		for (auto &c : s) putchar(c);
	}

	template<typename Ty, typename... Args>
	Reimu print(const Ty &x, const Args &...args) {
		print(x); print(args...);
	}
}
using namespace FastIO;

const int P1 = 998244353, P2 = 1e9 + 7, half = 1000000;
Marisa mod(LL x, int P) { return (x %= P) < 0 ? x + P : x; }

const int pow10[] = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000, 10000000, 100000000};

int ans, tot1;
LL n, tot2;
Arr<LL, 10> s;
Arr<vector<int>, 10> vec;

Reimu init(int x, int v) {
	if (x > 6) return;
	vec[x].emplace_back(mod(tot1 - v, P1));
	s[x] += mod(tot1++ - v, P1);
	for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) init(x + 1, v * 10 + i);
}

Marisa check(LL x) { return x * half + half - 1 <= n && x * half * 10 > n; }
Reimu solve(int x, LL v) {
	if (v > n) return;
	if (check(v)) {
		for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
			int t = mod(tot2 + 1 - v * pow10[i], P1);
			int loc = lower_bound(vec[i].begin(), vec[i].end(), P1 - t) - vec[i].begin();
			ans = mod(ans + s[i] + 1LL * t * (int)vec[i].size() - 1LL * P1 * ((int)vec[i].size() - loc), P2);
		}
		tot2 += tot1;
	} else {
		ans = mod(ans + mod(++tot2 - v, P1), P2);
		for (int i = (!x); i < 10; ++i) solve(x + 1, v * 10 + i);
	}
}

int main() {
	read(n);
	init(0, 0);
	for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) sort(vec[i].begin(), vec[i].end());
	tot2 = -1; solve(0, 0);
	print(ans);
	return 0;
}
